answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation: each agent locks a deposit that only unlocks after a long horizon of honest work, so spinning up thousands of fake identities means locking real capital per identity. Like pigment spread thin across an ocean, a Sybil's stake dilutes to nothing, while one honest agent concentrates its deposit and earns attestations that compound. An attacker facing a 30-day lock and slashing on fraud pays the full deposit for every fake, so a thousand-identity flood costs a thousand deposits for near-zero return.
